item.description:
📝 Explore the roadmap →Priority areas#The roadmap is organized into five priority areas. We want to make sure that we not only offer the right primitives for the job, but also that they work well together. We will also continue to grow our engagement with the OAuth standards bodies, including the IETF OAuth and WIMSE working groups, to help the underlying standards evolve with the building blocks that agent identity needs.
